findingsFixed.finding: Breakaway-denied fallback could acknowledge a helper still confined to a kill-on-close job.
findingsFixed.fix: Refuse independent-launch denial before quitting; no inherited-job fallback. Startup errors stop and reap unacknowledged helpers.
findingsFixed.evidence: Source review, Windows-specific fixture updated to require refusal; actual Windows execution pending.

findingsFixed.finding: Elapsed-time reuse allowed a second helper before the first app-exit wait expired, and Save/Discard could blindly close after helper expiry.
findingsFixed.fix: Retain process/nonce readiness, recheck on every update quit including dirty-editor continuation, and never start a competing helper after accepted handoff.
findingsFixed.evidence: verified_update_hands_off_only_without_unsaved_edits passed with stale-helper and Discard assertions.

findingsFixed.finding: Shared plan filenames and unleased helper operations could race.
findingsFixed.fix: Per-attempt plans and output logs; named helper mutex serializes update-state ownership. A timed-out installer retains the lease until it exits.
findingsFixed.evidence: PowerShell syntax parsed and source reviewed; successful Windows fixture case now also rejects a duplicate handoff while preserving the first receipt. Windows behavior pending.

findingsFixed.finding: Fake installer split NSIS /D paths with CRT argv, making space-containing fixture paths invalid.
findingsFixed.fix: Read GetCommandLineW and emulate NSIS trailing /D directory parsing; assert silent /S prefix.
findingsFixed.evidence: Official NSIS command-line contract reviewed; Windows fixture execution pending.

findingsFixed.finding: Stale waiting records could be consumed before the full app-exit timeout; relaunch failures and removed downloads had weak recovery.
findingsFixed.fix: Respect full timeout, record relaunch/start failures, normalize image prefixes, validate cached installer/exe/cwd; missing installer clears cache for fresh download.
findingsFixed.evidence: Linux outcome and GPUI missing-download tests passed; Windows launch/log behavior pending.

findingsFixed.finding: Late question-answer acknowledgement could lock a new question set; UI could enqueue another answer before the asynchronous busy frame.
findingsFixed.fix: Bind submission and error to the question signature plus literal answers, and gate pending submissions locally.
findingsFixed.evidence: old_answer_receipt_does_not_lock_a_new_question_set and repeated CtrlEnter regressions passed; actual fixture emitted one text-kind answer and preserved composer draft.
